CustomField.description: The deal phase this item belongs to, stamped at creation from its group. Values are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the first four values of Transaction__c.Stage__c, including the hyphen in Post-Closing. Denormalised from the parent so the checklist UI and reports can filter by phase without a parent join. NO DEFAULT VALUE, deliberately - a plausible default would hide a fan-out that failed to stamp the phase.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Deal phase this item belongs to. Stamped when the item is created; it does not move when the deal advances.
CustomField.label: Stage
